reuse.why: The flag is threaded into the existing shared getMonthWideTargetCategories selector that every month-wide action already calls.

duplication.why: The hidden rule lives once in the selector; only minor repetition remains, e.g. copyPreviousMonth keeps an inline arg type instead of the new MonthWideActionArgs.

placement.why: The rule change sits in the shared selection function in budget/actions.ts where the other exclusions already live.

scope.why: Only the selector, the month-wide action signatures and focused tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Clean single-parameter extension of the selector; small inconsistency in that copyPreviousMonth does not reuse the shared args type.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions keep going through getMonthWideTargetCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the hidden filter is a single conditional SQL fragment in the shared selector.
